versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated runtime/run.mjs with changes (details not specified).
- No user-facing workflow or requirements changed.

- Updated internal runtime documentation in references/runtime.md.
- Improved runtime logic and CLI discovery handling in runtime/run.mjs and runtime/yaps-cli-discovery.mjs.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of yaps-auto-captions skill.
- Enables adding and editing captions to videos using Yaps (v2.3.124+ required).
- Users review and correct caption text and timing before export.
- Supports choosing from installed style catalogues, with guidance for social-media-style default.
- Emphasizes safe file handling and explicit handling of errors and dependencies.
- Comprehensive workflow and operational boundaries provided in documentation.
